$comment: Generated from @mdn/browser-compat-data. Edit the prose here; re-run scripts/build-compat.mjs to refresh versions.
note: Edge tracks Chrome for every feature listed; it is omitted rather than duplicated.

groups.overlay: Popover, Tooltip, HoverCard, Select and menus

rows.name: <dialog>.showModal()
rows.degrade: Nothing renders as a dialog. No fallback — but this shipped everywhere in 2022, so in practice the invoker row below is what decides support.

rows.name: Invoker commands (commandfor)
rows.degrade: Triggers do nothing at all. bedrock ships no click handler to stand in for them, by design, so this row is the real support floor.

rows.name: ::backdrop
rows.degrade: No dimmed overlay. The dialog still opens, traps focus and closes.

rows.name: <dialog closedby>
rows.degrade: Clicking the backdrop will not close the dialog even if you ask for it. Escape and the Close button are unaffected.

rows.name: Popover API
rows.degrade: No top-layer promotion, so overlays are clipped by ancestor overflow and fight z-index — the exact class of bug this library exists to remove.

rows.name: popover=hint
rows.degrade: Tooltips use the ordinary popover stack, so opening a tooltip closes an open menu instead of layering above it.

rows.name: Anchor positioning (anchor-name)
rows.degrade: Overlays render centred in the viewport instead of beside their trigger. Readable, usable, wrong-looking.

rows.name: position-area
rows.degrade: side and align are ignored; default placement applies.

rows.name: Position fallbacks (position-try)
rows.degrade: No automatic flip near a viewport edge — an overlay can open partly offscreen instead of flipping to the other side.

rows.name: interestfor
rows.degrade: Hover and focus intent falls back to JavaScript timers. Behaviour is equivalent; the bundle is bigger and the delay is not tunable from CSS.

rows.name: appearance: base-select
rows.degrade: Select renders as a native OS dropdown: fully accessible, entirely unstyleable. Options with icons or two-line labels will not render as designed.

rows.name: @starting-style
rows.degrade: Enter transitions are skipped — things appear instantly. Exit transitions still play.

rows.name: transition-behavior: allow-discrete
rows.degrade: Exit transitions are skipped: the element is removed from display immediately, so a fade-out never plays.

rows.name: transition: overlay
rows.degrade: The element leaves the top layer the moment it closes, so its exit transition plays underneath other content instead of above it.

rows.name: interpolate-size
rows.degrade: Height cannot animate to auto, so open/close is an instant jump instead of a slide. No measuring effect is added to compensate.

rows.name: calc-size()
rows.degrade: Same as above, for sizes derived from the intrinsic one.

rows.name: :open selector
rows.degrade: Open-state styling on dialog, details and select silently does nothing. bedrock emits no data-state, so there is no fallback selector.

rows.name: :popover-open selector
rows.degrade: Open-state styling on popovers silently does nothing. Note this is a separate selector from :open, which does not match popovers.

rows.name: <details name>
rows.degrade: Accordion loses single-open exclusivity: every item can be open at once, and type="single" is not honoured.

rows.name: ::details-content
rows.degrade: The content wrapper cannot be styled or animated as one box.
